renameType.description: When specified, the type will be renamed to the supplied value

removeTypeField.description: When specified, will remove a field named with the supplied value from the type being refactored.

renameAnnotationInFields.description: When specified, will be rename annotation with name as the first element. The new name is the second element.

removeMixins.description: When specified, the supplied values indicate the type names that are going to be removed from any type mixing them.

removeExtends.description: When specified, the supplied values indicate the type names that are going to be removed from any type extending them.

renameRefType.description:
Renames any Type reference in all the fields inside the type.
The first element is the old type name and the second the new type name.

This method will replace them as strings in their ValueType definition, this means that complex fields will also be updated.
Example:
  Using { renameRefType: {fst: 'X', snd: 'Y'} }
      myField: X  => myField: Y
      myArray: [X] => myArray: [Y]
      myFunc: function (x: X)  => myFunc: function(x: Y)

replaceExtends.description: When specified, if the type extends the type in the first element, will replace it with the type in the second element.

replaceMixin.description:
When specified, if the type mixes the type in the first element, will replace it with the type in the second element.
The types listed in the third element will be ignored during the replacement.

renameTypesContaining.description:
When specified, all types containing a specific substring will be replaced with a different substring, excluding types
specified in a blacklist.
Format: {
  fst: string // the substring to search for in the type name
  snd: string // the substring to replace the first substring with
  thd: [string] // a list of types to exclude from the renaming operation
}

removeParamsWithType.description: Removes any parameter of the given type from all methods

addAnnotation.description: Adds an annotation to the type

addParameterToAnnotatedMethod.description:
Given the Triple X, Y, Z. Adds a parameter named Z.fst.fst with documentation Z.fst.snd of type Z.snd and remove params named Z.thd to any method annotated with X.
The Y value is the position of the parameter.

addPrefixToRefType.description:
When specified, will add a prefix to all type references within a type definition.
The types listed in the second element will be ignored from adding a prefix.

addPrefixToExtends.description:
When specified, will add a prefix to all type extends within a type definition.
The types listed in the second element will be ignored from adding a prefix.

addPrefixToMixins.description:
When specified, will add a prefix to all type mixins within a type definition.
The types listed in the second element will be ignored from adding a prefix.

title:
Provides an API to refactor c3typ files by providing the type declaration as a string.
Each field can be specified once per instance but you can use a list of instances to apply the
same refactor "method" multiple times.
name: DslRefactor
